Trishakti Power Generation Corporation 
 Office of the Executive Engineer · West Bengal · IN 
 
 No. CC/25/2016/044 
 Dated: 31/03/2026 
 
 CERTIFICATE OF COMPLETION OF WORK 
 This is to certify that the work of "Water Treatment Plant - West Bengal Pkg-44" (water
 treatment), awarded to M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (GSTIN 19NAICC4417O1Z1, PAN
 NAICC4417O) , has been completed in all respects on 16/04/2016 at a gross executed value of Rs.
 1783.00 Lakh (Rupees 17.83 Crore Only). 
 
 The agency attended to all observations raised during execution and the work was taken over on
 satisfactory completion of the final inspection. 
 The work was supervised on the contractor's side by Pooja Sen. This certificate is issued for record
 and for submission with future tenders wherever the contractor is required to establish past
 performance. 
 
 
 
 Executive Engineer 
 Trishakti Power Generation Corporation
